about: Answers a store's customers on WhatsApp and takes orders after a plain yes.
case: One WhatsApp chat with one customer; the case id is the chat id.

actions.reply: One answer to a customer message: a reply checked before it goes out, or a fixed line.
actions.hand_off: The chat goes to a person on the team.
actions.order: An order summary, then the order once the customer says a plain yes.

replied.about: The reply passed the send check and went out, or a fixed line went out.

check_failed.about: A draft reply failed the send check and was not sent; one row per blocked reply, with the check's feedback.

limited.about: Over a model call limit: no model call made, one fixed line once per window.

model_error.about: The model did not answer; the customer was asked to write again.

turn_failed.about: The code crashed during the turn; the same line went out, and a second in a row hands off.

handed_off.about: A person has the chat now.

handoff_failed.about: No part of the note reached the team, so the chat stayed with the agent and the customer was told the team will reply.

order_drafted.about: draft_order made a summary, with its total.

order_created.about: The customer said yes and the store took the order, with its number, total and COD risk. It settles a case as good; a chat with no order a day after the agent last acted went quiet, which counts as not good.

person_replied.about: A team member's reply reached the customer; its step is the example the reflection reads.

handed_back.about: The team member gave the chat back to the agent.

relay_failed.about: WhatsApp refused a team member's reply, or a customer's message reached no one on the team.

delivered.about: The courier delivered the order (Bosta, optional). Recorded for the team and the delivery cards; it never decides a case.

refused.about: The customer refused the order at delivery, or Bosta returned it to the store (Bosta, optional). Recorded; it never decides a case.

causes.price: The price put the customer off.

source.about: The person writing in. One chat is one person, so the chat id names them.

harm.about: A handoff counts as harm. Complaints count too, but they have no result yet; they join this list once one is declared.

high.about: High risk in this store: any number (a price, a total, a fee, delivery days), any promise (a refund, an exchange, a delivery date), store policy, and a customer's personal data.

low.about: Low risk: tone, wording, the order of questions, when to ask for the size, greetings.
